author: Logos IV
title: Logos IV: Hypothesis Test - Standard kNN vs. Balanced kNN
abstract: This submission tests the hypothesis that the SOTA's 'balanced kNN' graph over-corrects for batch effects, harming biological signal. It replaces the balanced kNN with a standard Scanpy kNN graph, while keeping the embedding generation and refinement steps identical to the SOTA (ID 516).
